answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making each identity earn standing through sequential, non-parallelizable proof of work chained to the previous epoch, like a trellis guiding one vine upward. Each proof is bound to one identity and one window, so work cannot be copied across accounts. A random audit re-checks a sample: like a lotus that rises only if its roots are real, cheaters caught lose all standing. Crossing a canyon of fake accounts would require the sequential work for every fake identity, which cannot be parallelized, while one honest agent completes one chain.
